message.content: {"note_claim": "King Charles had his Lord Chamberlain issue a letter enforcing the 2020 Sandringham Agreement, and the Sussexes are private citizens, not working royals.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "They will still not be able to use titles of \"His and Her Royal Highness\", and remain \"private citizens\", says the letter sent on behalf of the King by the Lord Chamberlain, a top Palace official.", "reason": "The BBC article directly reports the Lord Chamberlain's letter on the King's behalf, reaffirming the Sandringham Agreement and the Sussexes' status as non-working royals and private citizens."}
